allow_instructions: Read-only git commands are fine to auto-run: status, diff, log, show, branch -a, rev-parse, and similar inspections.
Read-only GitHub/GitLab CLI inspections are fine: gh pr view, gh pr list, gh issue view, gh issue list, glab mr view, glab issue view.
block_instructions: Always require approval for any git commit (including commit -a, commit --amend, and commit via git -C).
Always require approval for any git push (any remote, branch, tags, or --force).
Always require approval for creating or updating pull requests / merge requests: gh pr create, gh pr edit, glab mr create, glab mr update.
Always require approval for creating or updating issues: gh issue create, gh issue edit, glab issue create, glab issue update.
Always require approval for commenting on pull requests, merge requests, or issues: gh pr comment, gh issue comment, glab mr comment, glab mr note, glab issue comment, glab issue note.
Always require approval for merging, closing, or reviewing PRs/MRs via CLI: gh pr merge, gh pr close, gh pr review, glab mr merge, glab mr close.
